school.school_name: 専門学校越生自動車大学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Prevent official-index trust from converting an explicitly old-year confirmation-form PDF into strict FY2026 success.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure page.
Open the 修学支援 disclosure section and inspect the confirmation-form anchor.
Follow the PDF link labelled 令和七年度大学等における修学の支援に関する法律第７条第１項の確認に係る申請書.
Reject it from strict FY2026 success because 令和七年度 is fiscal year 2025.
Keep the school visible as publication-lag evidence for operator review instead of marking the current target year acquired.

reusable_rules: Use the official-index disclosure page before SERP fallback.
Parse kanji era numerals such as 令和七年度 as fiscal-year evidence.
Treat explicit old-year confirmation-form anchors as publication-lag evidence even when the URL came from the current prefecture index.
anti_patterns: Do not trust a WordPress upload path year or prefecture-index current-year evidence over an explicit old-year anchor.
Do not count an old-year confirmation form as target-FY success just because it is on the latest public disclosure page.

evidence.notes: Windows v244 full Saitama replay accepted this PDF because 令和七年度 was not parsed. The correct strict FY2026 outcome is fiscal_year_mismatch:2025/publication_lag_latest_public.
